newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian parliament replaces state media chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian parliament replaces state media chiefs.

text.p: Bulgaria's parliament has replaced directors of state media appointed under the former Socialist government, state radio said on Friday.
Deputies voted on Friday to replace Milen Valkov as director of state news agency BTA with Panayot Denev, a longstanding employee of the agency, the radio said.

On Thursday, parliament elected composer Stefan Dimitrov to head the national television in place of Ivan Tokadzjiev, and journalist Lilyana Popova from the Democratsia daily to replace Vecheslav Tunev at the national radio.
The Socialist opposition in parliament boycotted the vote, saying the replacements were political and contrary to the country's radio and television law.
